clue.text: Submariners meeting for private prayers

definitions.meaning: the Royal Navy's submarine arm has long been nicknamed for working unseen and unheard
a gathering where worshippers pray quietly to themselves, without words spoken

explanation.surface: Submarine crews gather for quiet personal devotions.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a nickname for the submarine fleet, and a church gathering held in quiet, wordless prayer.

clue.text: He stays to get a plug

definitions.meaning: one who stays or halts something, read as an agent noun
a bung or cork closing a bottle

explanation.surface: A man stays on in order to obtain a plug.
explanation.definitionFit: One who halts things is an agent noun of 'stop'; the same word names a cork or bung.

clue.text: Many a bully is reformed by soothing music

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a crossword stand-in for many

indicators.note: a bully who is reformed is changed, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Plenty of bullies turn over a new leaf thanks to gentle music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is reformed' rearranges L (Roman fifty, from 'Many') together with ABULLY.
explanation.definitionFit: A cradle song sung to send a child to sleep is gentle, calming music.

clue.text: Pole starting a quarrel proves inflexible

indicators.note: the pole comes at the start, ahead of the quarrel

parts.note: S stands for the South Pole
a tiff is a minor quarrel

explanation.surface: A Polish man who picks a fight turns out to be unbending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person but is S, one of the earth's poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigid and unbending are synonyms of the answer.

clue.text: Umpire not in time to boost the economy

parts.note: a referee, shortened to ref, is an umpire
late means not punctual

explanation.surface: A tardy umpire is asked to stimulate economic growth.
explanation.definitionFit: Governments stimulate activity by expanding the money supply again, the opposite of deflating.

clue.text: A type of stress

parts.note: type here means a printing typeface, the sloping one used to emphasise words, not a kind of anxiety

explanation.surface: A kind of pressure or strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloping print is the typeface writers use to give words emphasis.

clue.text: 999 clergymen Alec assembled

indicators.note: assembled means put together, so these letters are built into a new order

explanation.surface: Ninety-nine-nine clergymen named Alec gathered together.
explanation.walkthrough: 999 is the British phone number for the police, fire brigade and ambulance; 'assembled' rearranges CLERGYMEN ALEC.
explanation.definitionFit: Dialling 999 in Britain makes an urgent phone request for police, fire or ambulance help.

clue.text: Lower a small hood

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a cowl is a monk's hood

explanation.surface: Bring down a little hood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower' rhymes with 'flower' here: it means to frown, not to bring down.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower (rhyming with 'flower') is to frown or look sullen.

clue.text: Lottery the trustees win outright

parts.note: a sweep, short for sweepstake, is a lottery
a body of trustees is a board

explanation.surface: Trustees scoop a lottery jackpot.
explanation.definitionFit: To take every prize or trick available is to triumph completely.

clue.text: Paper-receptacle is given a short trial

parts.note: brief means short
a court case is a trial

explanation.surface: A document holder gets a quick hearing in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat bag for carrying documents holds papers.

clue.text: A wailing woman is a woman in woe

indicators.note: the woman is placed in the word for woe

parts.note: bane means a cause of misery or woe
she is a pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A crying woman is a woman in distress.
explanation.walkthrough: In Irish folklore a wailing spirit whose cry foretells a death.
explanation.definitionFit: In Irish legend this female spirit keens to foretell a death.

clue.text: To justify oneself is no longer simple

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
plain means simple

explanation.surface: Self-justification has stopped being straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To account for one's conduct is to give reasons, to justify oneself.

clue.text: Passionate American involved in brief love affair

indicators.note: the American is wrapped up in the short romance

parts.note: a fling is a brief romance

explanation.surface: An ardent American gets caught up in a short romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent or fiery feeling, as in a blazing row.

clue.text: Jerusalem composer has to evade questions

definitions.meaning: Sir Hubert ... set Blake's poem Jerusalem to music
to fend off or deflect a question, as a fencer turns aside a blade

explanation.surface: The man who wrote the hymn must dodge awkward questions.
explanation.walkthrough: Jerusalem is a famous English hymn, a setting of Blake's poem; it is not the city here.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the English composer Sir Hubert, and to deflect a question or blow.

clue.text: Sycophants producing earrings?

definitions.meaning: toadies who attach themselves to the powerful
jewellery that dangles from the ear, whimsically called things that hang on

explanation.surface: Flatterers who produce ear jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: hangers-about who cling to the important, and ear pendants that literally dangle on.

clue.text: Taken to the snuggery first and cuddled

indicators.note: the snuggery comes first, before the word for taken

parts.note: a nest is a snug, cosy place
led means taken or guided somewhere

explanation.surface: Led off to the cosy room first, then hugged.
explanation.definitionFit: Snuggled up close, as in an embrace.

clue.text: Man with skill engages top gear

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
address can mean dexterity or skill

explanation.surface: A skilled man engages the highest gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top gear' suggests driving, but means clothing worn on the head; 'address' in the old sense of adroitness.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear means clothing, and this is what is worn on top, on the head.

clue.text: Albert married a unique person in social work

parts.note: Al is short for Albert
a oner is a unique person or thing, one of a kind

explanation.surface: Albert wed a one-off who works in social care.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a hospital social worker who saw to patients' welfare.

clue.text: Doctor has a second spasm of severe intensity

parts.note: a tic is a twitching spasm

explanation.surface: A doctor suffers another severe fit.
explanation.definitionFit: Extreme and far-reaching, as with harsh measures.

clue.text: Showing joins in material is sordid

explanation.surface: Cloth with visible stitching is grubby.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: fabric full of stitched lines, and the unpleasant underside of life.

clue.text: Under a linden tree of towering grandeur

parts.note: sub means under
the lime is another name for the linden

explanation.surface: Beneath a tall linden of magnificent stature.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme, awe-inspiring beauty or majesty.

clue.text: One beset by mental disorder

indicators.note: the one is surrounded by the jumbled letters
disorder signals that the letters of mental are mixed up

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone troubled by a psychological illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' turns MENTAL into ALMENT, and 'beset by' puts I inside it; the whole clue also describes the illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A sickness or complaint, which a mental disorder is.

clue.text: Medical man consumed by pride and pomposity

indicators.note: the medical man is swallowed up inside pride

parts.note: a boast is something one takes pride in
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, stands for a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor is eaten up by arrogance and self-importance.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflated, pretentious language shows self-importance.

clue.text: An intellectual giant can admit gratitude

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the can holds the gratitude

parts.note: a tin is a can
ta is a colloquial British thank-you

explanation.surface: A great mind can confess to being thankful.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of enormous stature, here in mind; from the giants of Greek myth.

clue.text: The lovely Italian lady has blooming lips

definitions.meaning: plural of labellum, the lip-shaped petal of a flower such as an orchid

explanation.surface: The Italian beauty has full red lips.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: Italian for 'the beautiful one', and the botanical plural for flowers' lip-petals.

clue.text: Given a commentary on Dante at work

indicators.note: work, read as a verb, means the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Received critical notes on Dante while at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at work' looks like one phrase, but 'at' is part of the letters and only 'work' signals the rearrangement of ONDANTEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplied with explanatory notes, as a scholarly edition is.

clue.text: In photos the bride always looks perfect

indicators.note: the answer sits within the words as a picture appears in a photograph

explanation.surface: A bride always appears flawless in her wedding pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Flawless, the model of excellence.

clue.text: Sombre and self-contained in Africa

parts.note: dark means sombre or gloomy
continent means self-restrained, controlling oneself

explanation.surface: Gloomy and reserved while in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: An old European name for Africa, once little mapped by outsiders.
